reply.passport: Sure, {{name}}. Your counsellor needs your passport to check your visa options. Upload the photo page and I’ll save it to your profile.
reply.saved: Your passport is saved and your counsellor can now check your visa options. What would you like to do next?
reply.counsellor: Of course. 22 counsellors are online now. I’ll pass your details to the next available one.
reply.offer: Your offer from the University of Sydney needs a reply within 5 days. Open the Accept your offer task on your dashboard to continue.
reply.visa: You’re on the Student visa (subclass 500) path. Upload your passport and I can check your options.
reply.other: I can help with your offer, visa, documents and counsellors. Pick one to get started.
